title: Obsidian is glass made by a volcano
body: Obsidian forms when lava cools before crystals can grow. The resulting rock is usually dark and has a glassy texture, even though it formed as part of a lava flow.
takeaway: How fast rock cools can change its texture even when its chemistry stays the same.
source: US Geological Survey, Volcano Hazards Program Glossary, Obsidian

title: Horseshoe crabs are closer kin to spiders than to crabs
body: The horseshoe crab has a broad shell and lives near the coast, but it belongs to the lineage that includes spiders and scorpions. Crabs are crustaceans, part of a different branch of the arthropods.
takeaway: A name can describe an animal's appearance without identifying its closest living relatives.
visual: a horseshoe crab moving along a rippled seabed

title: A tiny change in ocean pH can represent a much larger shift
body: NOAA reports that average surface ocean pH has fallen by about 0.1 since industrialisation. Because pH is logarithmic, this corresponds to roughly a 30% increase in hydrogen ion concentration.
takeaway: On a logarithmic scale, a small movement on the dial can hide a large proportional change.
source: NOAA Pacific Marine Environmental Laboratory, A Primer on pH
